cohort: 140 women with placental abruption delivered by cesarean section
finding: In cases of suspected placental abruption delivered by cesarean section, shorter DDI was associated with NRFHR as the indication for CS, and lower umbilical artery pH, but not significantly different neonatal or maternal composite outcomes.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery ranged from 32 to 36 weeks depending on the indication for CS.
